test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All enzymes are vitamins.

All vitamins are carbohydrates.

**Conclusions:**

I. All enzymes are carbohydrates.

Il. No enzyme is a carbohydrate.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09b251f8e95d69a45041fad0155dd92d319e2c3ab111d980f9aaf6bbf2e19c73.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All enzymes are carbohydrates → True (As, All enzym
es are vitamins and All vitamins are carbohydrates so, All enzymes are carbohydrates is True)

Il. No enzyme is a carbohydrate → False (As, All enzymes are vitamins and All vitamins are carbohydrates so, No enzyme is a carbohydrate is False)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows from given statements and Venn diagram.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
